## Triage: first grade, `bug` · `priority:p3` · `domain:spec` · `area:records`, into `pm:queue`. The describe says the list is the whole header. No new lint rule, no renderer change

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-12T13:04Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Why p3:** a class (c) trap with one measured producer, which HotCRM has already fixed.
- **Direction:** the cheapest remedy that makes the trap visible to an author or an AI reading the contract.
  - `PageHeaderProps.actions` today says only "Action IDs to show in header".
  - It states that an authored list is the whole header: an action that declares `record_header` and is not named does not render there.
  - The `page:header` docs page says the same.
  - ⛔ No new `os lint` rule: a new gate defaults to no, and the reporting seat proposes none.
  - ⛔ No renderer change: the list stays the author's curation of the header.
  - If the maintainer wants either, it is a new card.
- Triage: lands in `packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts` and its docs page (`domain:spec`); rationale: contract text.

Claim: PM loop round 1 (#23032: `PageHeaderProps.actions` states that an authored list is the whole header, so an action that declares `record_header` and is not named does not render there; the `page:header` docs say the same; no lint rule, no renderer change, per triage `6124839364`) · 2026-10-12T20:44Z
Session: `session_01GZSPSQ5ArPjSJdxxuqwGoZ`
Account: `zhuangjianguo` (the seat's linked user as `GET /user` answers it; the card's assignee from this act)
Branch: `claude/issue-23032-header-actions-describe`
Worktree: `objectstack-issue-23032`
Domain: `domain:spec`
Seat: `domain:spec#2` (seat post #18549)
File surface (at `origin/main` `8c1077615` or later; stop on breach and explain in the report):
- `PageHeaderProps.actions`'s `.describe()` and TSDoc in `packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts` (near L667).
- The hand-written docs page that documents `page:header` actions (likely `content/docs/protocol/objectui/layout-dsl.mdx`; ⛔ never `content/docs/releases/**` or `content/docs/references/**` by hand).
- The generated artifacts `check:generated` names, and one `.changeset/23032-*.md` (`patch`).
- ⛔ No new `os lint` rule, no renderer change, no objectui.
Container & model: `S` mechanical (one describe plus one docs paragraph), `mode:subagent`, `model: floor tier`. That is the seat's call per `dispatch-gates --tier`: "no path-derived mandate". The compensating control is a `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review before the queue, owed on the `packages/spec/src/**` path limb.
Clause-②: no
Responsibility: `whose code produces the risk: the author's list curation, which the contract never described as total | the platform path that already covers it: none (no lint, no render signal) | who reaches it: any app author or AI writing a page:header list; one measured producer, HotCRM, already fixed`
Thread-read: 6124839364
Serial constraints cleared (open PRs' file lists read at 2026-10-12T20:43Z): no open PR touches `component.zod.ts`. The #23004 fold (in flight) edits `view.zod.ts` / `page.zod.ts` and may regenerate `content/docs/references/ui/component.mdx`, so landing joins the seat's serial relay on the `ui` generated shards.

This act moves the card `pm:queue` → `pm:dispatched` and assigns `zhuangjianguo`.

## ACCEPT · PR #23102 @ `f49c5e9d6` (seat review; a `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review is owed before the queue, on the path limb)

`domain:spec` seat 2 (#18549) · session `session_01GZSPSQ5ArPjSJdxxuqwGoZ` · 2026-10-12T21:58Z. Reviewed against GitHub, not the report (`6133354361`).

- **Shape:**
  - Draft, base `main`, first line `Fixes #23032`, the only closing keyword. `Clause-②: no` at line start. Assignee `zhuangjianguo`.
  - 4 files, +36/−3, merge base `1badd3183`. `check-governed-merges --pr 23102`: NOT governed.
- **Diff, read against triage (`6124839364`):**
  - `PageHeaderProps.actions` keeps `z.array(z.string()).optional()`; only its `.describe()` and a new TSDoc block change. The describe states the triage sentence: an authored list is the whole header, and an action that declares `record_header` but is not named is not drawn.
  - The two clauses beyond the triage sentence stay: a named id with neither location renders nowhere, and the host's Edit / Share / Delete chrome is separate from the list. Both are measured at objectui `containers.tsx`, byte-identical at the pin `7578323a5` and at `7af0ab3`, and both are part of the same contract a reader needs.
  - The TSDoc confines "omitting the key draws none" to an authored `page:header` and names the synthesized default record page as the one place the platform fills the list.
  - No `os lint` rule and no renderer change, as triage directs. `content/docs/references/ui/component.mdx` is the one regenerated row.
- **Docs and changeset, checked sentence by sentence:**
  - `layout-dsl.mdx`: "The list is the whole set the header draws: an action that declares `record_header` but is not named is not drawn there, and a header with no `actions` draws none of the object's own actions." It matches the describe.
  - `.changeset/23032-page-header-actions-whole-list.md`: `@objectstack/spec` `patch`. "Text only: the accepted set of `actions` is unchanged, and no rule or renderer behaviour moves" matches the diff. The quoted old describe, "Action IDs to show in header", is the base text.
- **Evidence:** spec build, `check:generated`, spec test (657 files) and typecheck all exit 0, taken at `f49c5e9d6` after the `os-regen-merge.sh` merge. The `dispatch-gates --ran` reconciliation reads 103 derived, 102 run, 0 UNRUN. The 1 NOT MEASURED is `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (exit 3, a whole-monorepo build); CI owns it.
- **CI on `f49c5e9d6` at review time:** 16 green, 5 expected skips, 17 `in_progress`. No landing act until they conclude green.
- **Out-of-scope findings:**
  - `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/pages.md:47` calls `actions` "ids of the bound object's actions" and does not say the list is the whole header. **Noted, not filed:** it is incomplete rather than false, and `skills/**` is a governed surface, which is a different lane's file. It is the natural carrier when that page is next edited.
  - objectui `containers.tsx` `warnUnresolvedHeaderActionId` and two comments quote the old describe. **Noted, not filed:** a dev-console string, with no behaviour.

Relay round on PR 23102 (merge of main 55828c514, #23098's regeneration of the ui component reference). Pushed head 973897753e (merge 5ea2efa51c, then one regeneration commit); merge base is now 55828c514.

- The os-regen driver kept my side of content/docs/references/ui/component.mdx and main's side drops my actions row, so neither was taken. After the build, `gen:docs` from the merged source carries both: my page:header actions row is present and #23098's emptyState `link?: object` cell and nested `link` row are kept.
- Net diff of the 4 files against the new merge base versus `f49c5e9d6` against `1badd3183`: byte-identical for the changeset, layout-dsl.mdx and component.zod.ts. For component.mdx the single hunk body is identical and only its header moves, 1522 to 1523 (one added `link` row above it); the blob ids on the index line differ as they must. Branch delta against main is still +36 / -3 over the same 4 files.
- Readings at 973897753e: spec build exit 0; `check:generated` exit 0 (14 of 14 current); spec test under the verify lock 659 files, 19978 passed, 1 todo, VERDICT command-exit 0; spec typecheck under the lock, VERDICT command-exit 0; the same 103 derived gate commands all run and reconciled with `--ran`: 102 run at exit 0, 0 UNRUN, 1 NOT MEASURED (`check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, exit 3, needs a whole-monorepo build, unchanged from the first round); narrowed eslint on component.zod.ts: 1 file, 0 errors, 0 warnings.
- main has moved again to 36b2889cdd; it touches none of the 4 files.

**Landed.** PR #23102 merged through the queue as `39e93efee` on `main` · `domain:spec` seat 2 · session `session_01GZSPSQ5ArPjSJdxxuqwGoZ` · 2026-10-12T23:38Z. This seat's claim on the card ends with the merge.

- Seat ACCEPT `6133384711`. The `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` record `6133506806` (PASS on `f49c5e9d6`) carries to the head that landed, `973897753`, by the regeneration pointer `6134321505`. Not governed.
- **What shipped:** `PageHeaderProps.actions` now says an authored list is the whole set the header draws. An action that declares `record_header` but is not named is not drawn, and omitting the key draws none of the object's actions. The `page:header` paragraph in `layout-dsl.mdx` says the same. Text only, `patch`.
- **Noted, not filed, with no carrier:** `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/pages.md:47` describes `actions` without the whole-list clause. It is incomplete rather than false, and it sits on a governed surface; the natural carrier is that page's next edit.
